name: INVADER
source:
You awaken in a dark creepy room: 10 terrified strangers are standing next to you and one voice – ‘’Vega’’, an unhinged android – is cackling about your impending doom.

Welcome to ‘’INVADER’’ a twisted death game where survival hinges not just on your brawn and brains, but on how far you’re willing to bend your morals to survive. These grotesque death challenges will push your sanity to the brink and erode any sense of moral decency you have.

[From [url=https://reikodium.itch.io/invader]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一个黑暗而令人毛骨悚然的房间里醒来：10个惊恐的陌生人站在你旁边，一个声音——“Vega”，一个精神错乱的机器人——正在咯咯地谈论你即将到来的厄运。

欢迎来到“INVADER”，这是一款扭曲的死亡游戏，生存不仅取决于你的体力和大脑，还取决于你为了生存愿意牺牲道德的程度。这些怪诞的死亡挑战会将你的理智推向边缘，并侵蚀你的道德正直感。

[来自[url=https://reikodium.itch.io/invader]itch.io[/url]]
